content.title: NYCRUNS Brooklyn Experience Half Marathon 2026 | Run This One
content.text: Browse Events Get Involved About Log in On April 26th, 2026, over 25,000 runners will complete a remarkable running journey at the NYCRUNS Brooklyn Experience Half Marathon, one of the nation's biggest, and Brooklyn's best, half marathon!The iconic route starts in hip North Brooklyn and winds around the waterfront taking you under the historic Williamsburg, Manhattan, and Brooklyn Bridges while delivering eye popping views of Manhattan.From there, the route heads up the historic concourses of Fulton Street & Flatbush Avenue before passing through Grand Army Plaza and into fabled brownstone Brooklyn before finishing in Prospect Park. Fundraiser Progress Event Goal: $750,000.00 $343,185 raised Includes External Funds External Amount: $178,589 We support all fundraising efforts for the NYCRUNS Brooklyn Experience Half Marathon 2026! This includes non-profits using their own platforms. To ensure a complete picture, please track funds raised externally and share them with us.
